headline: Approved salary increases for Executive Director and Assistant Director, adopted 2026 budget, and approved routine transfers and refunds.
summary: The board approved refunds and rollovers, transfers, new members, financial reports, and monthly warrants. It also approved a 5% base salary increase for the Executive Director and a $5,000 market adjustment plus 5% COLA for the Assistant Director, both effective January 1, 2026. The board approved the 2026 budget with an amended salary line from $215,087.08 to $231,087.08, and postponed a vote on the COLA percentage for retirees until a future meeting.
decisions: Approved the December 16, 2025 meeting minutes, 3-0, with Donna Matarazzo abstaining.
Approved refunds and rollovers for Christopher Auld Moroni and Dianna Militello, 4-0.
Approved transfers for Demiana Ramzy, Deanna Atwood, Margaret Dyer, and William Buonopane, 4-0.
Approved new members Myles Wright, Maribel Jimenez, Daleon Fashaw, Keith Sonia, Julia Long, and Liane De Paula Lopes Ayres, 4-0.
Approved financial information including cash books and PRIT statements for November and December 2025, 4-0.
Approved the Retiree Payroll Warrant of $1,402,690.87 and Cash Disbursements Warrant of $226,844.61, 4-0.
Approved a 5% base salary increase for the Executive Director effective January 1, 2026, 5-0.
Approved a $5,000 market adjustment and 5% COLA increase to base salary for the Assistant Director effective January 1, 2026, 5-0.
Approved the 2026 budget as distributed with an amendment to the salary line from $215,087.08 to $231,087.08, 5-0.
